title: Distribution-Dependent Improvements of McDiarmid's Inequality via Rényi Divergence
summary: We investigate whether Rényi divergence can sharpen McDiarmid's inequality and its distribution-dependent refinement induced by KL divergence. Starting from Marton's transportation proof, we show that its transport inequality fails in general when KL divergence is replaced by Rényi divergence of order $0<α<1$. For sums of independent bounded random variables, however, the additivity of Rényi divergence allows us to adapt the argument and derive concentration bounds.
